description: Get the status of an analytics export and its download link. Returns export_job (export_status, rows_count, is_truncated, file_name, file_size_bytes, error_text, expires_time), download_url and download_url_expires_time. download_url is null until export_status is DONE. The export runs in the background: export_status goes QUEUED -> RUNNING -> DONE or FAILED. Poll analytics_export_status until DONE or FAILED, not more often than once per ~10 seconds. When DONE, download_url is a direct link valid for 15 minutes (call analytics_export_status again for a fresh one). The file is served gzipped with Content-Encoding: gzip: a browser saves plain CSV or JSONL, from a shell use curl --compressed -o file.csv "<download_url>". Files are deleted 7 days after creation. No rows are returned through MCP, only the status and the link.

export_id.description: The export ID (_id returned by analytics_export_create)

name: analytics_export_status
